correctness.rationale: For 0<alpha<pi and s>0 the intrinsic distance is the hyperbolic cosine law with shortest modular angular gap. Exact radial sections integrate to a continuous three-case elementary area formula. Expansion yields G exp(R)-alpha+O(exp(-R)), and alpha plus G uniquely recovers s. Independent direct angular quadrature verifies all three ranges and limits across four parameter pairs; the proof, not the checks, handles all parameters.
